exposure: Supplies like drugs and blood for transfusion
outcome: Readiness of district and regional hospitals to provide two key Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEmONC) functions, caesarean section and blood transfusion
cohort: All forty-three (43) district and nine (9) regional hospitals in Burkina Faso
finding: Only 27.8% of hospitals in Burkina Faso at the time of the study could continuously offer caesarean sections and blood transfusion services.
